Spglib 2.7.0 source from https://github.com/spglib/spglib at tag `v2.7.0`
(`12355c77fb7c505a55f52cae36341d73b781a065`).

AtomX vendors the C library's `src/*.c`, `src/*.h`, and public `spglib.h`.
The unused Fortran wrapper `spglib_f.c` is omitted. `src/version.h` was
generated from upstream `version.h.in` for this fixed release. The upstream
BSD-3-Clause license is reproduced in `COPYING`.
